author: sleepyluke
body:
probly other can answer better but roughly for shifter corvus dungeons, you want  
  
\- your crit at 95% (less if your willing to go lower and use a few centaurius armor adorns) but you risk not critting before the buff.  
\- avidity of 15% from adorns (bristles/monoceros horns)  
\- blades of finesse spec (from blades of finesse guild, run 4 mans to get spec or solo with as much horde bonus as u can to make it go quicker, also new amity helps)  
\- defence below 380ish to get swash bonus from bof spec. (this means using broken gear and leveling up to give it anguish with demontooks and get bonus with crucible and all slots, then smelting it back to level 1 to keep defence on it lowest u can.  
\- you need some way of getting all or most of the buffs, either selfcasting or from gear or pet. buffs as attk1/attk2/t.attk1/t.attk2/t.attk3/t.all/t.all3/dex1/dex2/dex3. so u might want to switch our some of the cowards for items that give these (assassin/dulla boots etc).  
\- you want foresight above 650ish if u can.  
\- after all this ramp your attk as much as u can.

body: pet u usually use greater questing beast (it gives bezerk and some attk buffs) or pet that gives t.all like penguin or prom (if one of these, you usually wear beastfelled chest that gives bezerk).
